senses.gloss: ऐष्टक॑ mfn. (fr. इष्टका), made of bricks (as a house), Hcat.
ऐष्टक॑ (अम्), n. the sacrificial bricks collectively, ŚBr.
ऐष्टिक mf(ई)n. (fr. इष्टि), belonging or relating to an Iṣṭi sacrifice, relating to sacrifice, ĀśvŚr. Comm. on VS.; Hcat. &c.
to be performed in the manner of an Iṣṭi sacrifice Comm. on KātyŚr.
ऐष्टिक—पौर्तिक mfn. connected with sacrifices and with doing good works (not included under the head of sacrifices), Mn. iv, 227, (अन्तर्वेदिकं बहिर्वेडिकं च, Kull.)
